text: Instructions- Gap Quizzes Digital Transformation Program 	 7 Fundamentals digital gaps assessment, July/August 2022 (Station version)	 Deadline: Please complete all parts of this by Monday, August 8, including scheduling a team meeting to discuss after completing the quizzes as individuals.	 	 Reach out to Ryan Jenot (rjenot@poynter.org) if you have any questions about this gap quiz.	 	 Getting started	 *	Note that there are two tabs of gap assessments (one for Fundamentals 1-6 and one for Fundamental 7). Please fill out each one. *	At the top of each tab's spreadsheet enter your initials or name in row 5 under one of the response columns. 	 STEP ONE: Answer the statements separately as individual team members	 *	"Read each statement and Indicate whether you agree or disagree by entering a “1"" under either the ""agree"" or the ""disagree"" columns next to the statement." *	Answer each statement based on your own assessment of your organization. *	Don't over contemplate: give your quick, initial response. If mostly the case, answer “agree.” If not at all the case, answer “disagree”. *	If the statement is about an area where you have limited knowledge or perspective, answer the question anyway based on what perspectives and impressions you do have. *	If the wording of the statement doesn't quite fit your particular organization, consider the statement's intent and answer accordingly. *	Please answer every statement under each Fundamental. (If you skip some statements it will affect the gap scoring.) *	Allow about an hour to complete the entire assessment (both tabs). You can do it in multiple sessions if need be, though completing it in one session is preferred. 	 STEP TWO: Preparing to meet as a team	 *	There are columns for up to eight respondents. Use as many slots as you have team members and be sure every team member completes the assessment. *	Once everyone has answered fully, you can see your team’s gap assessment scores. Statement scores appear under column AD. Overall individual and team scores for each fundamental are shown at the bottom of the section for each fundamental (e.g. rows 18 and 19 for Fundamental #1). Summary tables of scores across the Fundamentals can be seen at the bottom of the sheet. *	Please schedule and hold a team meeting by Monday, August 8 to review and discuss your results as a group, and determine what gaps your team sees as a priority to address, particularly in the context of choosing a digital challenge in this program.
